integrity: Exact proof and independent finite reproduction recorded; finite tests are not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Fermat cubic over \(\mathbb Q\) and all primes \(p\ge5\). Counts rational geometric type-nine points, not all rational points or equations of osculating cubics. Relies on published complete coordinate enumeration; possible unindexed overlap; no independent scientific verification.
title: Prime-by-prime rationality spectrum of the 72 type-nine points on the Fermat cubic
